Lead source: self-serve signup via quickstart + Github template (Next.js). Indie dev founders (2 people) building a paid mobile/web note-taking app with embedded AI features. CRM-style, shorthand notes below:

- 2026-02-14: user signed up with personal email, claimed $50 free credits. created api key, installed node SDK (vercel deployment).
- 2026-02-16: first API call (chat/generation) — quick smoke tests, avg latency observed ~180ms (short prompts) from Vercel region us-east.
- 2026-02-18: tried embeddings for search; small dataset (~2k docs). relevant recall ok, experimenting with chunking.
- 2026-02-20: used up initial free credits on heavy sampling for prompt tuning. left note in signup form: "love the latency, pricing looks tight for scale".
- 2026-03-04: automated alert: hit rate limit on burst traffic (unexpected), created support ticket SUP-1982. No AE/SE outreach yet.
- 2026-03-12: Growth email sent offering one-time trial extension + tips on batching & prefix caching; user replied asking about predictable monthly costs and single-tenant options in future.

Requirements summary (from founder messages):
- Workload: conversational chat (real-time messages), embeddings-backed search, occasional code completion for power users.
- Latency target: <=250ms for typical chat turn; tail latency matters for UX.
- Throughput: low-moderate (initially 5-20 requests/minute; expected to scale during marketing spikes).
- Cost sensitivity: high. want predictable per-month spend, will optimize prompts and caching.
- Model preferences: open to smaller open models for cost, but wants compatibility with higher-quality variants for paid tier.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted API; would like automatic fallback to cheaper model variant if cost spike.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 desirable but not blocking; SSO/SAML not needed immediately but desired for team onboarding later; US data residency preferred.

Observed fit & suggested approach:
- Good PLG fit: small team, built on Vercel, already integrated SDK, low friction to convert with incremental credits + clear cost playbook.
- Short-term ask: extend trial credits + provide docs snippet on batching/response streaming and embedding cost tips.
- Mid-term: show pricing scenarios for expected MAU growth (5k -> 50k) and simple guardrails (quota alerts, rate-limit rules).

Next steps (short):
- Growth follow-up email (done 2026-03-12). include one-pager on cost optimization and a quick optional 30-min intro call with SE.
- If they accept intro call, book SE time to cover model recommendations and routing policies (can show hosted-only plan first).

Quotes/rep language captured:
- "We shipped an MVP and the latency is already good — pricing is the main question before we commit."
- "If we can lock down predictable monthly spend, we can move forward with a small paid plan for beta users."

Other notes: founder mentioned investor deck review in April; converting to paid before investor demo is a high-impact gating event. Keep outreach lightweight and developer-centric (code snippets, example costs).
